summary.text: Jeffrey McClain is the Republican candidate for Ohio House of Representatives District 87 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously represented District 87 in the Ohio House from 2009 to 2016 and served as Wyandot County Auditor for more than 26 years.

paragraphs.text: Jeffrey McClain graduated from Upper Sandusky High School and earned a bachelor's degree in accounting from Tiffin University.
His professional experience includes serving as the Wyandot County Auditor for over 26 years.
McClain assumed office in the Ohio House of Representatives, District 87, in 2009 and left office in 2016.
During that time his committee assignments included Finance and Appropriations, Ways and Means, Transportation, Public Safety and Homeland Security, and the State Controlling Board.
He advanced from the Republican primary on May 5, 2026.
